<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR STYLE="font-size: 10pt">
    <TD STYLE="padding: 0; font-size: 10pt; width: 78%; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Summary</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding: 0; font-size: 10pt; width: 22%; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">.01</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">
                                            <B>THE BANK&#8217;S NET INCOME</B> totaled Ps.275.2 billion in 1Q24. This result was <B>61%
                                            lower</B> than the Ps.679.3 billion posted in 4Q23 and <B>626% higher</B> than the Ps.37.9
                                            billion posted in 1Q23. In 1Q24 the <B>annualized return</B> on average equity (&#8220;ROAE&#8221;)
                                            and the annualized return on average assets (&#8220;ROAA&#8221;) were 37.4% and 11.9%, respectively.</FONT></P>




<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT> In 1Q24, <B>OPERATING INCOME
(before G&amp;A and personnel expenses)</B> totaled Ps.1.62 trillion, 19% or Ps.388 billion lower than in 4Q23 and 149% or Ps.969.3 billion
higher than the same period of last year.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT> In 1Q24, <B>OPERATING INCOME
(after G&amp;A and personnel expenses) </B>totaled Ps.1.25 trillion, 20% or Ps.322.7 billion lower than in 4Q23 and 211% or Ps.850.8
billion higher than the same period of last year.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT> In 1Q24, <B>BANCO MACRO&#8217;S
TOTAL FINANCING</B> decreased 10% or Ps.279.6 billion quarter over quarter (&#8220;QoQ&#8221;) totaling Ps.2.5 trillion and decreased
8% or Ps.205.9 billion year over year (&#8220;YoY&#8221;). In 1Q24 peso financing decreased 20% while USD financing increased 75%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT> In 1Q24, <B>BANCO MACRO&#8217;S
TOTAL DEPOSITS</B> decreased 1% or Ps.74.3 billion QoQ and 11% or Ps.644 billion YoY, totaling Ps.5 trillion and representing 76% of
the Bank&#8217;s total liabilities. Private sector deposits decreased 6% or Ps.291.2 billion QoQ. In 1Q24, Peso deposits increased, 10%
while USD deposits decreased 32%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT>
                                            Banco Macro continued showing a strong solvency ratio, with an <B>EXCESS CAPITAL</B> of Ps.2.6
                                            trillion, 46.5% Capital Adequacy Ratio &#8211; Basel III and 44.5 % Tier 1 Ratio. In addition,
                                            the Bank&#8217;s <B>LIQUID ASSETS</B> remained at an adequate level, reaching 124% of its
                                            total deposits in 1Q24.</FONT></P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT> In <B>1Q24,</B> the Bank&#8217;s
<B>NON-PERFORMING TO TOTAL FINANCING RATIO</B> was 1.14% and the <B>COVERAGE RATIO</B> reached 222.7%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT> As of <B>1Q24,</B> through its
<B>517 branches</B> and <B>9.166 employees Banco Macro</B> serves <B>5.18 million</B> retail <B>customers (</B>2.19 million digital customers)
across 23 of the 24 Provinces in Argentina and over <B>149,770 corporate customers.</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><IMG SRC="tm2415302d2_6kimg009.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B><I>As of December&nbsp;2023,
Banco Macro consolidated includes Banco Macro + subsidiaries + Banco BMA (formerly Banco Ita&uacute; Argentina)</I></B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Earnings per
outstanding</B> share were Ps.430.74 in 1Q24, 61% lower than in 4Q23 but 627% higher than the result posted a year ago.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Banco Macro&#8217;s
1Q24 net income</B> of Ps.275.2 billion was 61% or Ps.422 billion lower than the previous quarter and 626% or Ps.237.3 billion higher
YoY mainly due to the mark to market of Government Securities (financial assets at fair value through profit or loss). This result represented
an annualized ROAE and ROAA of 37.4% and 11.9% respectively. Total comprehensive income for the quarter totaled Ps.260.5 billion, 66%
lower than the result posted in the previous quarter.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Net operating
income</B> (before G&amp;A and personnel expenses) was Ps.1.62 trillion in 1Q24, 19% or Ps.388 billion lower compared to 4Q23. On a yearly
basis, Net Operating Income (before G&amp;A and personnel expenses) increased 149% or Ps.969.3 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q24, <B>Provision
for loan losses</B> totaled Ps.18.9 billion, 32% or Ps.8.7 billion lower than in 4Q23. On a yearly basis provision for loan losses increased
40% or Ps.5.4 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Operating income
</B>(after G&amp;A and personnel expenses) was Ps.1.25 trillion in 1Q24, 20% or Ps.322.7 billion lower than in 4Q23 and 211% or Ps.850.8
billion higher than a year ago.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="vertical-align: middle; width: 70%; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">It is important
to emphasize that <B>this result</B> was obtained <B>with a leverage</B> of only 3x assets to equity ratio.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: right; width: 30%">&nbsp;<IMG SRC="tm2415302d2_6kimg010.jpg" ALT="" STYLE="height: 82px; width: 250px"></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>The Bank&#8217;s
1Q24 net interest income</B> totaled Ps.167.5 billion, 40% or Ps.111 billion lower than in 4Q23 and 56% or Ps.211.3 billion lower YoY.
Interest income decreased 18% while interest expenses decreased 7%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
  <TD STYLE="padding-right: 0; padding-left: 0; text-indent: 0; width: 15pc"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>BANCO MACRO</B></FONT></TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: right; padding-right: 0; padding-left: 0; text-indent: 0">1Q24 EARNINGS RELEASE</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>In 1Q24 interest
income</B> totaled Ps714.8 billion, 18% or Ps.154.5 billion lower than in 4Q23 and 19% or Ps.172 billion lower than in 1Q23.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Income from
interest on loans and other financing</B> totaled Ps.462 billion, 18% or Ps102.8 billion lower compared with the previous quarter mainly
due to a 16% decrease in the average volume of private sector loans and a 118 basis points decease in the average lending rate. On a
yearly basis Income from interest on loans increased 39% or Ps.129.8 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q24, <B>income
from government and private securities</B> decreased 42% or Ps.68.3 billion QoQ (due to the unwinding of our Leliq portfolio) and decreased
82% or Ps.429.33 billion compared with the same period of last year. This result is explained 68% by income from government and private
securities through other comprehensive income (Other government securities) and the remaining 32% is explained by income from government
and private securities in pesos at amortized cost.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q24, <B>income
from Repos</B> totaled Ps.151.9 billion, 19% or Ps.24.3 billion higher than the previous quarter and 482% or Ps.125.8 billion higher
than a year ago.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q43 <B>FX income
totaled</B> Ps.80.6 billion,71% or Ps.196.5 billion lower than the previous quarter and 43% or Ps.61.6 billion lower than a year ago.
FX income gain was due to the 6.1% argentine peso depreciation against the US dollar and the Bank&#8217;s long dollar position during
the quarter. It is important to notice that the Bank&#8217;s long dollar position decreased 96% during the quarter.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The Bank&#8217;s
1Q24 <B>interest expense</B> totaled Ps.547.3 billion, decreasing 7% or Ps.43.5 billion compared to the previous quarter and 8% (Ps.39.3
billion) higher compared to 1Q23.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q24, <B>interest
on deposits</B> represented 96% of the Bank&#8217;s total interest expense, decreasing 8% or Ps.46.5 billion QoQ, due to a 970 basis
points decrease in the average rate paid on deposits while the average volume of deposits from the private sector increased 5%. On a
yearly basis, interest on deposits increased 6% or Ps.31.5billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 1Q24 <B>Banco Macro&#8217;s net fee income
</B>totaled Ps.74.1 billion, 12% or Ps.10.2 billion lower than in 4Q23 and was 13% or Ps.11.4 billion lower than the same period of last
year.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In the quarter, <B>fee income</B> totaled Ps.84.2
billion, 12% or Ps.11 billion lower than in 4Q23. In the quarter fees charged on deposit accounts decreased 13% or Ps.4.2 billion, credit
card fees decreased 14% or Ps.2.8 billion and Mutual funds and securities fees decreased 31% or Ps.1.3 billion. On a yearly basis, fee
income decreased 11% or Ps.10 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In the quarter, <B>total fee expense</B> decreased
7% or Ps.820 million. On a yearly basis, fee expenses increased 16% or Ps.1.4 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 1Q43 <B>Net Income from financial assets and
liabilities at fair value through profit or loss</B> totaled a Ps.1.27 trillion gain, decreasing 6% or Ps.84.9 billion in the quarter.
This gain was mainly due to the mark to market of some government securities (CER inflation adjusted bonds) (Ps.1.28 trillion).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="vertical-align: middle; width: 70%; text-align: left">On a yearly basis <B>Net Income</B> from financial assets and liabilities at fair value through profit or loss increased Ps.1.24 trillion.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: right; width: 30%">&nbsp;<IMG SRC="tm2415302d2_6kimg011.jpg" ALT="" STYLE="height: 77px; width: 150px"></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

billion while Other adjustments and interest from receivables increased 54% or Ps.5 billion).On a yearly basis, Other Operating Income
increased 100% or Ps.22.2 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 1Q24 <B>Banco Macro&#8217;s administrative
expenses plus employee benefits</B> totaled Ps.202.3 billion, 12% or Ps.28.9 billion lower than the previous quarter, due to lower employee
benefits (-1%) and lower (+28%) administrative expenses. On a yearly basis, administrative expenses plus employee benefits increased
49% or Ps.66.1 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Employee benefits</B> decreased 1% or Ps.1.5
billion QoQ, social security contributions and compensation and bonuses decreased 7% or Ps.1.6 billion while Compensation and bonuses
decreased 7% or Ps.1.3 billion. On a yearly basis, Employee benefits increased 47% or Ps.42.4 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 1Q24, <B>administrative expenses</B> decreased
28% or Ps.27.4 billion, due to lower Directors and auditors fees(-60%), lower other professional fees (-37%) lower advertisement and
publicity fees (-43%) and lower other administrative expenses (-16%). On a yearly basis administrative expenses increased 52% or Ps.23.7
billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 1Q24, <B>the efficiency ratio</B> reached
14.7%, improving significantly from the 18.6% posted in 4Q23 and much better than the 25.5% posted a year ago. In 1Q24 expenses (employee
benefits + G&amp;A expenses + depreciation and impairment of assets) decreased 13%, while income (net interest income + net fee income
+ differences in quoted prices of gold and foreign currency + other operating income + net income from financial assets at fair value
through profit or loss &#8211; (Turnover Tax + Insurance on deposits)) decreased 11% compared to 4Q23.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 1Q24, <B>Other Operating Expenses </B>totaled
Ps.139.6 billion, decreasing 18% or Ps.30 billion QoQ, due to lower turnover tax (13% or Ps.13.5 billion), lower initial loan recognition
charges (Ps.9 billion) and lower Other expenses (12% or Ps.5.4 billion). On a yearly basis, Other Operating Expenses increased 51% or
Ps.47.1 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>In 1Q24, the result from the net monetary
position totaled a Ps.889 billion loss, 12% or Ps.91 billion higher than the loss posted in 4Q23 and 159% or Ps.546.2 billion higher
than the loss posted one year ago. </B> This result is a consequence of a higher net monetary position (+84%) which was partially
offset by lower inflation during the quarter(167 b.p. below 4Q23 level, down to 51.6% from 53.3% in 4Q23).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Loans and other financing</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>The volume of financing</B> (including loans,
financial trust and leasing portfolio) totaled Ps.2.5 triillion, decreasing 10% or Ps.279.6 billion QoQ and decreasing 8% or Ps.205.9
billion YoY. In 1Q24 Private sector loans decreased 10% or Ps.279.8 billion. On a yearly basis Private sector loans decreased 8% or Ps.215.7
billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Within commercial loans, Overdrafts</B> stand
out with a 21% or Ps.92.6 billion decrease, <B>Documents decreased</B> 2% or Ps.10 billion while <B>Others</B> increased 2% or Ps.9.3
billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Within <B>consumer lending, personal loans</B>
decreased 12% or Ps.44.8 billion while <B>credit card loans</B> decreased 18% or Ps.132.1 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Within <B>private sector financing,</B> peso
financing decreased 20% or Ps.513.9 billion, while US dollar financing increased 75% or USD 254 million.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of 1Q24, <B>Banco Macro&#8217;s market share
over private sector loans</B> was 9.4%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q24, the <B>Bank&#8217;s
public sector assets </B>(excluding Central Bank notes) to total assets ratio was 47.3%, higher than the 31% registered in the previous
quarter, and higher than the 17% posted in 1Q23. Other government securities increased 50% (CER inflation linked bonds) which were partially
offset by a decrease in Dual Bond holdings.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Deposits</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Banco Macro&#8217;s
deposit base </B>totaled Ps.5 trillion in 1Q24, decreasing 1% or Ps.74.3 billion QoQ and an 11% or Ps.644 billion decrease YoY and representing
76% of the Bank&#8217;s total liabilities.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">On a quarterly
basis <B>private sector deposits </B>decreased 6% or Ps.291.2 billion while <B>public sector deposits</B> decreased 83% or Ps.234.2 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The decrease in
private sector deposits was led by <B>demand deposits</B>, which decreased 26% or Ps.777.3 billion, while time deposits increased 27%
or Ps.422.6 billion QoQ.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Within private
sector deposits, <B>peso deposits </B>increased 10% or Ps.365.2 billion, while US dollar deposits decreased 32% or USD 622 million.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">As of 1Q24, <B>Banco
Macro&acute;s market share </B>over private sector deposits was 7.5%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Other sources of
funds</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q24, the total
amount of <B>other sources of funds</B> increased 2% or Ps.84.3 billion compared to 4Q23 mainly due to a 8% or Ps.260.7 billion increase
in Shareholders&#8217; equity generated by the <B>positive net </B>income registered during the peiod. On a yearly basis, <B>other sources
of funds </B>increased 35% or Ps.981.2 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 1Q24, <B>Banco
Macro&#8217;s non-performing </B>to total financing ratio (under Central Bank rules) reached a level of 1.14%, down from 1.29% in 4Q23,
from the 1.41% posted in 1Q23.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Consumer portfolio
non-</B>performing loans deteriorated 12 b.p. (up to 1.47% from 1.35%) while <B>Commercial portfolio non-performing loans</B> improved
49 b.p. in 1Q24 (down to 0.72% from 1.2%).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>The coverage
ratio</B> (measured as total allowances under Expected Credit Losses over Non Performing loans under Central Bank rules) reached 222.7%
in 1Q24. Write-offs over <B>total loans</B> totaled 0.06%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The Bank is committed
to continue working in this area to maintain excellent asset quality standards.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 14pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Expected Credit Losses (E.C.L) (I.F.R.S.9)</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The Bank records
an allowance for expected credit losses for all loans and other debt financial assets not held at fair value through profit or loss,
together with loan commitments and financial guarantee contracts, in this section all referred to as &#8216;financial instruments&#8217;.
Equity instruments are not subject to impairment under IFRS 9. The ECL allowance is based on the credit losses expected to arise over
the life of the asset (the lifetime expected credit loss), unless there has been no significant increase in credit risk since origination,
in which case, the allowance is based on the 12 months expected credit loss.(For further information please see our 2023 20-F)</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<BR>

us that it has decided to authorize Banco Macro S.A. to distribute profits for an aggregate amount of Ps.294,130,168,000, in cash or
in kind, as requested by the Bank, which distribution shall be carried out in the terms provided by the standard set by Distribution
of Results. Pursuant to Communication &quot;A&quot; 7984, such amount shall be paid in constant currency of the payment date/s, after
re-expression of the relevant payable amount by applying the most recently published rate before the date on which each of the above-mentioned
instalments is made available according to the payment schedule duly fixed by the Board. <BR>
<BR>
On May&nbsp;14, 2024 the Board of Banco Macro S.A. resolved to apply the amount of&nbsp; Ps.294,130,167,680 to the payment of a cash
dividend in 3 equal and consecutive monthly instalments. The amount of each one of such instalments shall be paid in constant currency,
using the most recently published consumer price index (CPI) as determined by Instituto Nacional de Estad&iacute;sticas y Censos (INDEC)
to the date each instalment is made available to the shareholders.</FONT></TD></TR>

The amount shall be expressed in constant currency to the date of the resolution that determines the availability of such instalments.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Each time the Board resolves to make available a dividend instalment, it shall issue the relevant notice of payment, containing the following
information: i) the amount to be made available to the shareholders; ii) the amount per share; and iii) whether the dividend to be paid
is subject to any kind of tax withholding.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In addition, please be advised that pursuant to Communication &#8220;A&#8221; 7997 of the
Central Bank of the Republic of Argentina, in connection with the option to be granted to the non-resident shareholders to apply the
funds derived from the dividends received to the acquisition of BOPREALs, the Bank shall inform such possibility at the time of issuing
the relevant notice of payment of each dividend instalment.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The amount to be paid as dividend is subject to a 7% tax withholding under
section 97 of the Argentine Income Tax Law as revised in 2019 and, in the case of non-resident shareholders who choose to acquire BOPREALs,
an additional 17.5% tax withholding shall apply as Tax for an Inclusive and Solidarity-based Argentina (PA&Iacute;S) pursuant to Decree
No.&nbsp;385/2024.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Simultaneously with this notice, we published the notice of payment of the first dividend installment.</FONT></P>

statements of each company to the same date, as duly submitted to the Central Bank of the Republic of Argentina, the Argentine Securities
Exchange Commission (Comisi&oacute;n Nacional de Valores) and Bolsas y Mercados S.A.; and (iii)&nbsp;to omit reading the above mentioned
documents since they have been made available to the shareholders duly in advance and are copied on the relevant corporate books.</FONT></P>
